# Logical task ARCH-001

Title: Freeze the hackathon product, data, and acceptance contracts
Track: architecture

Frozen BASE_SHA: e7e4ee78826f213109955d345ed51a05839e4c0f
Expected workspace/branch: trk-architecture-arch-001

## Specification

Read the full PRD, sanitized API catalog, current Flask implementation, tests, and visual handoff. Produce an implementation specification, technical specification, data-source contract, and P0 acceptance matrix. Optimize for a reliable three-minute demo, not production completeness. Public interfaces that can safely return useful behavior data take priority; mocks are placeholders only. Freeze Duolingo and GitHub public-live mappings. Define a LeetCode public-live mapping only if a bounded read-only profile query is verified during this task; otherwise mark only its transport as verified and keep its product mapping Fixture. Keep, NetEase, WeRead, Steam, and credentialed GitHub GraphQL stay Fixture or unavailable. Separate baseline facts, current public-live evidence, Fixture behavior, and Roadmap. Treat API_INTERFACE_CATALOG.md as immutable input and do not edit application code.

## Acceptance

- Every P0 PRD capability is mapped to evidence, a concrete gap, or an explicit non-goal
- The data contract defines normalized tags and Public Live, Fixture, unavailable, timeout, invalid-input, malformed-response, and upstream-error states
- The technical spec defines exact worker boundaries, risks, acceptance tests, and a three-minute judge path
- No unsupported API, deployment, score, user, or business claim is presented as fact

## Exact write paths

- `docs/specs/**`
- `docs/contracts/DATA_SOURCE_CONTRACT.md`
- `docs/acceptance/**`

## Required checks

- `git diff --check`

## Dependency evidence

```bash
python scripts/gate.py init \
  --track architecture \
  --task ARCH-001 \
  --base e7e4ee78826f213109955d345ed51a05839e4c0f \
  --write-path "docs/specs/**" \
  --write-path "docs/contracts/DATA_SOURCE_CONTRACT.md" \

python scripts/gate.py check --preflight
```

The Orca worker preamble contains the actual task_... and dispatch_... IDs. Use those exact IDs in worker_finish.py.

- 可以读取全仓库，但只能写任务列出的 `WRITE_PATHS`。
- 禁止切换分支、合并、Rebase、Force Push、Hard Reset。

## 提交节奏

```bash
python scripts/gate.py check --run-checks
git add <owned-paths>
git commit -m "feat(<track>): <summary> [<LOGICAL_TASK_ID>]"
git push -u origin HEAD
```

已 push 提交不得 amend、rebase 或 force push；错误用新提交或 `git revert`。

## 最终完成

确认检查通过、工作区干净、HEAD 与远端一致后：

```bash
python scripts/worker_finish.py \
  --logical-task <LOGICAL_TASK_ID> \
  --task-id <ORCA_TASK_ID> \
  --dispatch-id <ORCA_DISPATCH_ID> \
  --base <BASE_SHA> \
  --outcome succeeded \
```
